theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_rb_l2_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (α : Type) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (f : ℕ → α → ℝ), (∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 μ) → (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ j, ∃ k ∈ S, ∫ x, (f j x - f k x) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ η) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (W : α → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ MemLp W 2 μ ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, (f (φ j) x - W x) ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
